name: Batam Marriott Hotel Harbour Bay
short_description: Batam's first five-star Marriott, a waterfront hotel above the Harbour Bay ferry terminal to Singapore, with sea-view rooms, an infinity pool and rooftop bar.
ai_summary: The Batam Marriott Hotel Harbour Bay is the island's first five-star Marriott, a 216-room waterfront property built directly above the Harbour Bay ferry terminal, giving guests near-seamless arrival from Singapore straight into the lobby. Independent reviewers consistently rank it the best hotel in Batam, praising warm, English-fluent service, spacious and spotless rooms, and higher-floor club rooms with genuine ocean and skyline views. Facilities that draw repeat praise include the outdoor infinity pool with harbour outlook, a well-equipped 24-hour gym, and the Altitude rooftop bar for sunset drinks. Dining spans the all-day Goji Kitchen & Bar and the Cantonese Jiang He, with several writers singling out the M Club lounge on level 11 as the property's highlight for breakfast and evening cocktails. Value is a recurring theme: reviewers frame it as noticeably cheaper than comparable Singapore hotels while feeling more polished than most Batam options. Honest watch-outs recur too. Some guests note a swampy or low-tide smell drifting up to the pool area, occasionally cold breakfast items, and confusion or extra charges around M Club access for suite and family guests. A few mention thin pre-arrival communication and isolated cleanliness complaints. On TripAdvisor it holds roughly a 4.0 rating and ranks near the top of Batu Ampar hotels.

faqs.question: How do I get to the hotel from Singapore?
faqs.answer: Take a ferry from Singapore's HarbourFront or Tanah Merah terminal to Batam's Harbour Bay terminal. The hotel sits directly above the terminal, with basement-level access from customs into the lobby, so it is only a short covered walk with luggage after clearing immigration.

faqs.question: Does the hotel have sea-view rooms and a pool?
faqs.answer: Yes. Many rooms and suites offer bay, sea or skyline views, with the best outlooks on higher club floors. The hotel has an outdoor infinity pool overlooking the harbour, plus a children's pool, a 24-hour fitness centre and the Altitude rooftop bar for sunset drinks.

faqs.question: How far is the hotel from Hang Nadim International Airport?
faqs.answer: Hang Nadim International Airport (BTH) is roughly 22 km away, about a 30 to 40 minute drive depending on traffic. Most international guests arrive by ferry from Singapore rather than by air, since the hotel connects directly to the Harbour Bay ferry terminal.

reviews.title: Batam Marriott Hotel Harbour Bay Review
reviews.summary: Overview of the 216-room five-star hotel above the ferry terminal, praising well-appointed rooms, three dining venues, the pool and gym, and strong value versus Singapore hotels.

reviews.title: Batam Marriott Hotel Harbour Bay
reviews.author: elizbeartravel
reviews.summary: A weekend stay praising ferry-terminal access, spacious rooms and 5-star service, but flagging a swampy pool-area smell at low tide, a hard sofa bed and some cold breakfast items.

reviews.title: Best New Hotel: Batam Marriott Hotel Harbour Bay, Indonesia
reviews.author: Gabriel Tan
reviews.summary: Names it Best New Hotel, highlighting spacious suites with skyline-view tubs, exemplary service, the infinity pool and jacuzzi, and standout Cantonese dining and M Club lounge.

reviews.title: Hotel Review: Batam Marriott Harbour Bay
reviews.author: Satu Kosong
reviews.summary: Calls it the best hotel in Batam for its level-11 M Club and ocean-view suites, but recounts frustrating pre-arrival contact and confusion over club-lounge access charges at check-in.
